'''''Ahsoka''''' is a young-adult novel from [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] released on [[October 11]], [[2016]]. The novel, written by [[E. K. Johnston]], centers on [[Ahsoka Tano]] in the period of time after she left the [[Jedi Order]] and before she became an operative in the rebellion. The title's [[Ahsoka (audiobook)|audiobook edition]] was narrated by [[Ashley Eckstein]], the voice of Tano on both ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="commentarytrack">{{SW|url=news/e-k-johnston-ahsoka-commentary|text=Commentary Track: Behind the Scenes of ''Ahsoka'' with E.K. Johnston}}</ref> The title was given a paperback release on [[October 3]], [[2017]].
